messages:
Samir K: Quick heads-up — while checking the release notes we hit a 404 in the docs preview. The page references a snippet anchor that no longer exists: https://docs.redwood.ai/snippets/compatibility-guide#snippet-ff2b

Samir K: Can whoever owns the snippets doc confirm: should we (a) restore the snippet, (b) add a redirect/alias, or (c) remove the anchor and update callers? Also, do we have a policy for keeping snippet IDs stable across refactors? cc @Elaine M @Mike H

DocsBot: automated-scan — broken link detected in /guides/release-notes -> referencing /snippets/compatibility-guide#snippet-ff2b (404). Severity: high. Scan ID: scan-20260316-09. Reaction: :rotating_light:

Elaine M: I can take this. Leaning toward add alias + update callers so we don't reintroduce the old snippet content unless necessary. I'll open a draft PR today.

Mike H: +1 for alias + update. Note re: implementation — our static site supports frontmatter aliases for path-level redirects but not anchor-only redirects. If you want an anchor reachable, easiest is to add the heading with the same id to the target doc. Example frontmatter snippet:
```yaml
aliases:
  - /snippets/compatibility-guide#snippet-ff2b
```
But anchors in aliases don't always work reliably across the CDN.

Jen L: FYI anchors are flaky with our CDN. If we need anchor-level compatibility for embedded links, I'd prefer creating a tiny redirect page (HTML meta refresh) or adding an explicit heading/id in the destination doc. That preserves deep links for external integrators.

Rachel P: I can run the preview build once the PR is up — staging deploy queue is about 10-15m right now. Also, please tag the PR with `docs-owner:snippets` so the snippets team gets pinged automatically.

Samir K: Thanks everyone. If we end up removing the snippet, let's add a short changelog entry and notify integrators via the #integrations channel.

Elaine M: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — added a new heading with id `snippet-ff2b` in the compatibility doc and added a frontmatter alias. Please review and comment if you think we should instead create a redirect page.

Mike H: Reviewing now. Quick local check: run `yarn docs:dev` then search for `snippet-ff2b` in the built HTML (`grep -R "snippet-ff2b" build/`).

Jen L: If the alias doesn't land the anchor, I'll submit a small follow-up that creates `/snippets/ff2b/index.html` with a meta refresh pointing to the new section — quick and reversible.

Rachel P: Preview build queued by CI. I'll post the preview link here when it's ready.

Samir K: Awesome, thanks Elaine + team.
